scenario: 今天的检索赛道在问，相关该为谁服务，相似度是否还等于意义。意图清楚却不指向单一类目时，最强向量检索加重量排仍离上界很远。有人把整条搜索栈对准下游推理效用，线上回答质量随之上升。列表式重排按检索名次像发牌一样拆候选，就能少做修复调用，局部图文检索则靠把区域看清，而不必先微调整座模型。另一边，无意义字符串可以在全库里胜过所谓最相关段落，说明稠密分数并不自动等于语义。检索增强生成开始按效用把上下文缝短，或让同一个模型在潜在空间里检索和生成。视频里的预训练信号也能靠纯文本优化被唤醒，表情包和电商重排则提醒：情感信号或专门打分器，有时比默认上大模型更贴使用场景。

papers.title: MIPR: A Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval with Multi-Category Solutions
papers.authors: Qiang Li, Xuan Lu, Jian Ruan, Manxi Lin, Jiacheng Chen, Wen Shen, Zhihua Wei, Xiaoyu Shen, Dan Ou, Xiangheng Kong, Junjun Zheng
papers.abstract: Real-world e-commerce queries often express user intent without naming a target product, and a single intent may be fulfilled by products from multiple categories. However, existing multimodal retrieval benchmarks typically assume a relatively well-defined target, leaving retrieval for intents with multi-category solutions less explored. To fill this gap, we introduce MIPR, a benchmark for Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval comprising 3,522 multimodal queries and a shared corpus of 30,731 products. MIPR features reasoning-intensive retrieval, multi-category solutions, and fine-grained relevance labels. Experiments show that the best embedding-based retriever achieves 49.23% nDCG@10 on the full query set, and 55.86% solution-category recall@10 on queries with multiple solution categories. Reranking improves these scores to 60.11% and 67.00%, respectively, yet substantial gaps to the candidate-pool oracle remain. These results establish MIPR as a challenging and diagnostic benchmark for evaluating multimodal intent-to-product retrieval. The data and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/leequeue/MIPR.
papers.summary: 真实电商查询常常只说出购买或使用意图、并不点名具体商品，而且同一意图可能由多个类目的商品来满足，现有多模态检索基准却多半假定目标已经比较明确。一份面向意图到商品检索的基准给出 3,522 条多模态查询和共享的 30,731 件商品语料，强调需要推理的检索、多类目解决方案，以及细粒度相关标注。最强的基于向量的检索器在全部查询上的十分位排序质量为 49.23%，经过重排后升到 60.11%，但离候选池上界仍有明显差距。这说明，意图清楚却不指向单一类目时，检索系统还远谈不上已经解决，基准本身更适合用来诊断，而不是只报一个总分。

papers.title: From Relevance to Utility: Rubric Alignment in Yuanbao Search
papers.authors: Yu Lu, Lixin Zou, Yangqi Chen, Hui Xu, Qiaolin Xia, Hao Wang, Qianwen Ma, Reed Li, Shuang Zeng, Haijin Liang, Haibo Shi
papers.abstract: Agentic search demands that a search engine move beyond per document relevance ranking to assemble document sets optimized for downstream LLM reasoning. Prior work addresses this either by improving individual pipeline stages in isolation or by applying RL based selection on top of relevance trained upstream modules, leaving the full stack unaligned to utility for reasoning. We propose rubric aligned search, a framework that unifies the traditional search pipeline under a single supervision surface. For each query, we derive a rubric from coarse to fine, specifying weighted positive criteria that the document set must satisfy and negative criteria that it must avoid. From this rubric we derive two training signals. First, a lightweight labeler distills rubric grounded judgments into per document utility labels, which supervise a contrastive dual encoder for retrieval and a multi task ranker trained with four rubric aligned scoring heads. Second, a rubric conditioned evaluator produces a set level reward that drives a dual branch RL selector, combining GRPO with best rollout distillation to resolve credit assignment in subset optimization. Deployed in Yuanbao Search, the pipeline improves end to end answer quality by 8.52% over the online production baseline.
papers.summary: 智能体搜索要求搜索引擎不再只按单篇文档的相关性排序，而要为下游大模型推理拼出一套真正有用的文档集合。既有做法要么孤立改进流水线里的某一段，要么在已经按相关性训练的模块之上再做强化学习选择，整条栈并没有对准推理效用。一套量规对齐的搜索框架为每个查询从粗到细写出加权的正面与负面标准，再由此得到两种训练信号：轻量标注器把量规判断蒸馏成文档级效用标签，用来监督对比双塔检索和带四个量规打分头的多任务排序器；量规条件的评估器再给出集合级奖励，驱动双分支强化学习选择器。部署到元宝搜索后，端到端回答质量相对线上生产基线提高 8.52%。

papers.title: Deal With It: On Better Schedules for Listwise Reranking
papers.authors: Benjamin Clavié, Herumb Shandilya, Hanna Lichtenberg, Aamir Shakir, Makoto P. Kato
papers.abstract: Listwise LLM rerankers cannot reliably rank hundreds of documents in a single call, and rely on schedules to orchestrate their calls. Parallel schedules split candidates into groups and advance a fixed quota from each. When a group holds more of the top passages than its quota, some are cut, and expensive repair calls become required. We show that the way candidates are split matters where such a quota can bind, and that, in expected cuts, the best split there deals them round-robin by retriever rank, like cards. Although not conceptually new, dealing has remained unanalyzed. We prove that, under a simple retriever model, no split with equal quotas cuts fewer of the true top ten on average, and that contiguous chunks cut more as the retriever improves. DealRank, the simplest schedule our analysis allows, is on average within 0.1 nDCG@10 points of the best schedules over six LLMs, in two rounds. It is consistently 1.1 to 1.4 times faster than BlitzRank with concurrent first calls up to a thousand candidates. There, it needs three rounds and is eleven times faster than the sliding window. In existing schedules such as BlitzRank, dealing reduces repair calls from 59% of queries to 14%, improving latency with no significant change in quality. Random partitioning appears equivalent at a quota of four, as predicted, but ties results to the seed and trails by 1.3 nDCG@10 points at a quota of one over a dense retriever.
papers.summary: 列表式大模型重排器很难在一次调用里可靠排好几百篇文档，必须靠日程来组织多次调用。并行日程把候选分组，每组只向前推进固定名额；当一组里的真正靠前段落多于名额时，就会被切掉，还得再花昂贵的修复调用。候选如何拆分，会决定这种名额何时真正卡住。分析表明，按检索器名次像发牌一样轮转分配，在期望切掉数量上是最好的等额拆分，而且检索器越好，整块连续切分切掉得越多。这一最简日程平均只比最强日程低 0.1 个十分位排序分，并在已有日程里把需要修复调用的查询从 59% 降到 14%，延迟下降而质量没有显著变化。

papers.title: LoCaR: Localized Canvas Retrieval With Frozen Vision-Language Model
papers.authors: Rahim Hossain, Dipanwita Saha, Ashirbad Mishra, Xinxin Shu, Svetlana Strunjas, Binbin Li
papers.abstract: Whole image embeddings can under represent small objects and local attributes that distinguish relevant images for localized queries. We present LoCaR, a training free framework for localized text to image retrieval with frozen vision language models. LoCaR constructs and utilizes independent proposals (SAM2) focusing on the object so as to get a more localized representation that independently encodes each region using the frozen visual encoder. We further study paired-support adaptation as an optional residual that uses matched text region exemplars without updating the underlying encoders. We also introduce LOCFG, a Visual Genome derived benchmark designed to evaluate localized retrieval for smaller and more challenging referents. Across several vision language backbones, our results show that improving the region representation itself is the main source of gain.
papers.summary: 整图向量常常稀释掉小物体和局部属性，而这些细节正是局部查询用来区分相关图像的依据。一套无需训练的框架在冻结的视觉语言模型上做局部图文检索：先用独立区域提案把注意力落到物体上，再让冻结视觉编码器分别编码每一块区域，从而得到更局部的表征。可选的成对支持适配只作为残差，利用成对的文本-区域样例，并不更新底层编码器。一份从 Visual Genome 派生的基准专门用来评估更小、更难指代对象的局部检索。在多种视觉语言骨干上，主要收益来自把区域表征本身做得更好；在 CLIP 上，加上可选适配后，区域第一位召回提高 2.42 个百分点。局部检索要先把区域看清，而不是先去微调整座模型。

papers.title: NONSENSE: Non-Semantic Strings Expose Semanticity Gaps in Dense Retrieval
papers.abstract: Dense retrieval is central to modern search, question answering, and retrieval-augmented generation, where high similarity is often treated as evidence of semantic relevance. We examine how far this assumption can be stressed. NONSENSE is a black-box sparse-edit probe that constructs visibly non-semantic strings while forbidding query-term copying, optimizing only the dense similarity between a query and the string. Across five BEIR-style datasets and three popular single-vector retrievers, these strings frequently outscore the retriever's own best judged query-relevant passage (QRP), and often rank first in the full corpus. The result indicates a semanticity gap in the evaluated dense retrievers: nearest-neighbor status can be separated from passage-like meaning. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating dense retrievers not only by whether they retrieve relevant documents, but also by how reliably their similarity scores reflect semantic evidence.
papers.summary: 稠密检索已经被用在搜索、问答和检索增强生成里，人们也常把高相似度直接当成语义相关的证据。一套黑盒稀疏编辑探针专门来压这个假定：它构造一眼就能看出没有语义的字符串，禁止抄写查询词，只优化查询与字符串之间的稠密相似度。在五个类似 BEIR 的数据集和三种常用单向量检索器上，这些字符串经常超过该检索器自己判断为最相关的段落，并且常常在全库里排到第一。例如在 SciFact 上，对 E5 有 97.7% 的查询，无意义字符串得分超过最佳相关段落，中位排名是第 1。这说明近邻身份可以被从段落式意义里拆开，评估稠密检索器时，不能只问它有没有找回相关文档，还要问相似度是不是真的在反映语义。

papers.title: StitchRAG: Constructing Compact and Evidence-Preserving Contexts for RAG with Diffusion-Based Stitching
papers.authors: Minsang Kim, Junpyo Lim, Heeje Cho, Seungjun Baek
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality by grounding large language models (LLMs) in external evidence. However, long retrieved contexts incur computational overhead and can even hurt performance due to noisy or irrelevant content. We propose \textsc{StitchRAG}, a framework for constructing compact context in RAG. \textsc{StitchRAG} builds a faithful, information-dense context while dynamically compressing the retrieved passages. We adapt the size reduction ratio to each passage by formulating a utility maximization trading-off the retained information and computation costs. We then extract answer candidates and query-related keywords from passages as anchors and collect passage sentences containing anchors under the derived size constraint. Finally, we connect or stitch the collected sentences together using text diffusion to form a coherent and natural context. Experiments on five open-domain QA benchmarks show that \textsc{StitchRAG} consistently outperforms diverse multi-step and compression baselines. Extensive ablations show the effectiveness of dynamic size allocation, anchor preservation, and diffusion-based stitching.
papers.summary: 检索增强生成靠外部证据提高事实性，但过长的检索上下文既贵，又可能被噪声段落伤害回答。一套紧凑上下文方法按篇动态决定该压多少：在保留信息与计算代价之间做效用最大化，再从段落里抽出答案候选和与查询相关的关键词作为锚点，在长度约束下收集含锚点的句子，最后用文本扩散把这些句子缝成连贯自然的上下文。五个开放域问答基准上，它持续优于多种多步与压缩基线，检索上下文平均被压到原来长度的 72.29%；在 HotpotQA 上，相对经典检索增强生成，精确匹配提高 2.4 分。对要控制上下文预算的系统来说，==该留什么应当按效用来分配，而不是按固定比例一刀切。==

papers.title: Latent Abstraction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Ha Lan T. Nguyen, Nguyen Anh Minh, Dung D. Le
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, mitigating hallucinations, and improving factuality. However, existing systems rely on generating natural language queries at each hop and maintaining a strict architectural separation between retriever and generator, preventing them from leveraging the full representational capacity of the LLM. We propose LAnR (Latent Abstraction for RAG), a unified framework in which a single LLM jointly performs encoding, retrieval, and generation entirely within its own latent space. Rather than generating textual queries, LAnR produces dense retrieval vectors from the hidden states of a designated [PRED] token and uses them to match against encoded document representations from the same model. Furthermore, LAnR adaptively decides when sufficient evidence has been retrieved using a lightweight MLP control head over those same hidden states, eliminating explicit token-level stopping reasoning. Extensive experiments on five QA benchmarks spanning single-hop and multi-hop settings demonstrate that LAnR outperforms existing RAG methods, while achieving improved inference efficiency through reduced number of retrieval calls and tighter model integration.
papers.summary: 检索增强生成通常每跳都先写出自然语言查询，并把检索器和生成器严格分开，模型自己的表征能力用不全。一套统一框架让同一个大模型在潜在空间里同时做编码、检索和生成：不再生成文本查询，而是从指定预测位置的隐藏状态取出稠密检索向量，去匹配同一模型编码出的文档表示；再用一个轻量控制头看这些隐藏状态，自适应判断证据是否已经足够，不必再做显式的停止推理。五个覆盖单跳与多跳的问答基准上，该方法优于现有检索增强生成做法，并减少检索调用。在只训练了部分数据的设置里，它在 HotpotQA 上精确匹配达到 0.419，在 2Wiki 上达到 0.408，并在未见过的多跳数据上仍然领先。

papers.title: VidVec: Unlocking Video MLLM Embeddings for Video-Text Retrieval
papers.authors: Issar Tzachor, Dvir Samuel, Rami Ben-Ari
papers.abstract: Recent studies have adapted generative Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into embedding extractors for text-vision tasks, typically by fine-tuning them to produce universal representations. However, their performance on video-text retrieval often remains below that of dedicated Video Foundation Models. In this paper, we revisit the video-text retrieval capabilities of MLLMs. We first analyze the zero-shot retrieval capabilities of pretrained MLLMs and show that they already encode substantial retrieval-relevant information: combining intermediate-layer embeddings with a calibrated MLLM head yields strong performance without any training. To further exploit these capabilities, we introduce a lightweight text-based optimization strategy that requires no paired multimodal data. Our method uses dense video captions as rich textual surrogates for video semantics and short summaries as compact, query-like views, showing that a carefully designed text-alignment objective can improve multimodal alignment through the shared MLLM backbone. We backup these findings through in-depth analysis. Remarkably, our lightweight text-only optimization outperforms its counterpart trained with paired video-text supervision, which is substantially more computationally expensive. Furthermore, our method outperforms existing approaches, often by a substantial margin, and achieves state-of-the-art performance across common video-text retrieval benchmarks. More broadly, our findings highlight the untapped retrieval capabilities of pretrained MLLMs and establish text-only optimization as a more efficient and effective substitute for large-scale visual supervision.
papers.summary: 人们常把生成式多模态大模型微调成通用 embedding，用来做图文任务，但它们在视频-文本检索上往往仍落后于专门的视频基础模型。对预训练模型的零样本分析显示，它们其实已经编码了大量与检索相关的信息：把中间层嵌入与校准过的模型头结合起来，不必训练也能得到很强的结果。再辅以一种轻量的纯文本优化，用密集视频说明充当视频语义的替代、用短摘要充当像查询一样的紧凑视角，就能通过共享骨干改进多模态对齐，而且不需要成对的多模态数据。这种纯文本优化甚至超过用成对视频-文本监督训练、计算贵得多的对照；在 MSR-VTT、VATEX 和 DiDeMo 上，分别再提升 2.3%、6.2% 和 6.8%，并在常用视频检索基准上达到当时最好的水平。

papers.title: CARE: Conversational Affective Response Retrieval for Internet Memes
papers.authors: Jiajun Li, Leihan Zhang, Teng Zhang, Le Zhang, Qiang Yan
papers.abstract: Conversational meme retrieval supports response selection in online communication, where relevance depends on both contextual meaning and affective expression. We study this task using two language-specific collections from Douban and Imgflip, containing 98,506 meme records across 5,583 discussion topics. Thread membership supplies weak relevance labels, while likes provide implicit ranking feedback. Automatically extracted sentiment, facial-expression indicators, and cross-modal consistency features support an exploratory analysis of engagement. We propose CARE, a Conversational Affective Response Retrieval framework that combines an emotion-enhanced CLIP retriever with a Jina-based reranker. The retriever incorporates free-form emotion descriptors through gated fusion and learns from multiple positive examples per query. The reranker combines query--image interactions with emotion representations and is trained using engagement-based ranking supervision. Under the reported topic-held-out protocol, CARE achieves Hit@10 of 24.03\% on Douban and 49.33\% on Imgflip, compared with 23.16\% and 41.07\%, respectively, for fine-tuned CLIP. These results support the utility of the complete two-stage system for recovering thread-associated memes. They do not independently establish perceived social resonance or isolate the contribution of affect from reranker training. The study provides a basis for further evaluation of affect-aware retrieval with human relevance judgments and controlled comparisons.
papers.summary: 会话里检索表情包，既要看上下文含义，也要看情感表达是否对得上。一项研究用豆瓣和 Imgflip 两个语料，覆盖 5,583 个讨论主题下的大量表情记录，用帖子归属作为弱相关标签，用点赞作为隐式排序反馈。一套情感增强的检索加重排框架，把自由形式的情绪描述经门控融合进检索器，并让重排器同时利用查询-图像交互和情绪表征，再用互动信号做排序监督。在按主题留出的协议下，Imgflip 上前十命中率为 49.33%，细调 CLIP 为 41.07%；豆瓣上的提升更小。作者也提醒，这些结果还不能单独证明感知到的社交共鸣，也不能把情感模块的贡献从重排训练里完全分开，后面仍需要人工相关性判断和对照实验。

papers.title: Using Jev as a search reranker: benchmarks and how to implement
papers.abstract: We had Jev score Elasticsearch hybrid search results and let a short Python policy do the reranking, taking nDCG@10 from 0.9351 to 0.9565
papers.summary: 电商搜索要把混合检索的结果再排一遍时，不一定只能把候选交给大模型。一篇实践记录让 Jev 给 Elasticsearch 的混合检索结果打分，再用一段很短的 Python 策略做重排，把十分位排序质量从 0.9351 提到 0.9565。这条路径把重排从一次生成式调用，变成一次可嵌入现有检索栈的打分与策略组合，便于在线上反复试验阈值和截断。对已经有混合检索、又希望控制重排成本的团队来说，这是一种不必先上大模型重排器的替代。当然，这一数字来自该文报告的评测设置，换一批查询或另一种混排公式，幅度未必相同，但方向是清楚的：==重排可以由专门的打分器加短策略来做==，而不必默认生成式大模型。
